lineage: V2.1b (V2.1 re-execution with private stochastic drive)
sealed: pre-execution; no plant run under shot drive precedes this commit
single_delta: additive per-neuron drive schedule x_i(t) = s_i(t) - mu_c (private filtered Poisson shot noise, mean-controlled); nothing else changes

frozen.plant: tests/test_v21_operation.py build_plant (C-min, static s=1 efficacies, cells, topology) as executed for results/v21_{low,mid,high}.json
frozen.engine_internal_noise: JaxFNE 0.4.24 simulate_edge_recurrent_izhikevich noise_scale=None -> 0.5*N(0,1) native current per neuron per step, keyed per step from PRNGKey(11); kept as executed in V2.1
frozen.gates: V2.1 run_regime verbatim (E 2-30 Hz; PV/SST/VIP >=1 Hz; ISI-CV in [0.5,1.5] for >=80% CV-evaluable; E rate-CV >=0.3; sync <0.01; drift <=20%; currents recorded-not-tuned)

shot.process: per neuron, per step: k ~ Poisson(p = lambda*dt), i.i.d. across neurons and steps (numpy PCG64(shot_seed), float64)
shot.kernel: exponential, s[t] = d*s[t-1] + A*k[t], d = exp(-dt/tau)
shot.tau_justification: plant's own excitatory receptor tau (receptor_index 0 = 2.0 ms); no new time constant introduced
shot.mean_control: A = mu_c*(1-d)/p so the discrete stationary mean equals mu_c = class tonic of the regime; s starts at mu_c; schedule carries s - mu_c, so total mean input equals the frozen V2.1 tonic
shot.precision: float64 generation and filtering; cast to float32 at the schedule boundary (max cast error recorded per cell)

bracket.axis: sigma/mu (H3 declared control variable). At fixed mu and tau, rate x amplitude has one free coordinate: lambda = 1/(2*tau*(sigma/mu)^2), A follows from mean control
bracket.rationale: 2.0 and 1.0 inside the H3 viable region (sigma/mu ~ 1+); 0.5 is the bracket edge toward the continuous limit, still 2x below the falsified 2 kHz rate

excluded.reason: 2 kHz/amp 2.0 weak regime falsified (CV 0.344) and high-rate continuous limit inferred clock-like (h_history.json)

realization_gate.statistic: per class over analysis windows: |mean(s)/mu_c - 1| <= mean_tol and |mean_i sd_i(s)/mu_c / sigma_over_mu_discrete - 1| <= sigma_over_mu_tol
realization_gate.failure: cell cannot PASS; verdict UNRESOLVED if no cell passes

verdict_rule: PASS if any cell passes all V2.1 gates and its realization gate; FAIL if all 9 cells complete, realized, and none pass; UNRESOLVED otherwise. Passing subset reported; no cell or regime selected
recorded_not_gated: per-class rate ratio vs results/v21_<regime>.json (output-rate shift; gating or correcting it would be tonic re-derivation, forbidden)

internal_noise_discrepancy.observed: V2.1 plant is not deterministic: seed 11 vs 12 at HIGH -> max |dV| 101.7 mV, 7720 differing spike events in 500 ms; noise_scale=0 -> |dV| 0.0; same seed bitwise identical
contradicts: v21b-symmetry results/h_defect.json 'No irregularity/heterogeneity source exists in the frozen candidate'
v21b-symmetry results/h_history.json 'the C-min V2.1 plant itself was never tested with noise'
internal_noise_discrepancy.corrected_reading: V2.1 carried weak private white current noise and was still clock-regular (ISI-CV pass 0.0, E rate-CV <=0.004). The defect is insufficient fluctuation, not absent fluctuation; this is consistent with H3 (high-rate/weak limit clock-like) and does not by itself falsify H5
internal_noise_discrepancy.decision: freeze as executed (human decision, 2026-09-16); shot drive is the single delta on top

pre_execution_findings.magnitude_vs_internal_noise: shot low-frequency PSD (mu^2/lambda) exceeds internal white PSD (0.25*dt) by >=200x for E/PV/VIP in all cells; SST ratio by cell (sm2p0/sm1p0/sm0p5): LOW 21/5/1, MID 223/56/14, HIGH 891/223/56 (internal noise not negligible for SST in LOW cells)
pre_execution_findings.risk_noted: charge per event mu/lambda is large at sigma/mu=2 (E HIGH 147, VIP up to 443 native current*ms): single events may be suprathreshold (event-copy regime, output rate near lambda). Adjudicated by gates, not adjusted
pre_execution_findings.import_trap: editable jomission install resolves to stale E:\jomission when cwd is not on sys.path; battery asserts jomission imports from this repo
